1.web: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
1.asv: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

2.web: He looked, and behold, a well in the field, and, behold, three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.
2.asv: And he looked, and, behold, a well in the field, and, lo, three flocks of sheep lying there by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and the stone upon the well’s mouth was great.

3.web: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again on the well’s mouth in its place.
3.asv: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in its place.

4.web: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
4.asv: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence are ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

5.web: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
5.asv: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

6.web: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”
6.asv: And he said unto them, Is it well with him? And they said, It is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

7.web: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”
7.asv: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

8.web: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we water the sheep.”
8.asv: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

9.web: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
9.asv: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep; for she kept them.

10.web: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
10.asv: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

11.web: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
11.asv: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

12.web: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.
12.asv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.

13.web: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.
13.asv: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

14.web: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” He lived with him for a month.
14.asv: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

15.web: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my brother, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
15.asv: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

16.web: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
16.asv: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

17.web: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
17.asv: And Leah’s eyes were tender; but Rachel was beautiful and well favored.

18.web: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
18.asv: And Jacob loved Rachel; and he said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

19.web: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
19.asv: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

20.web: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
20.asv: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

21.web: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
21.asv: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

22.web: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
22.asv: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

23.web: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him. He went in to her.
23.asv: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

24.web: Laban gave Zilpah his handmaid to his daughter Leah for a handmaid.
24.asv: And Laban gave Zilpah his handmaid unto his daughter Leah for a handmaid.

25.web: In the morning, behold, it was Leah. He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”
25.asv: And it came to pass in the morning that, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

26.web: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
26.asv: And Laban said, It is not so done in our place, to give the younger before the first-born.

27.web: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me yet seven other years.”
27.asv: Fulfil the week of this one, and we will give thee the other also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

28.web: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.
28.asv: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife.

29.web: Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah, his handmaid, to be her handmaid.
29.asv: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her handmaid.

30.web: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
30.asv: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

31.web: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
31.asv: And Jehovah saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

32.web: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction. For now my husband will love me.”
32.asv: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Because Jehovah hath looked upon my affliction; for now my husband will love me.

33.web: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.
33.asv: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and said, Because Jehovah hath heard that I am hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

34.web: She conceived again, and bore a son. Said, “Now this time will my husband be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.
34.asv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have borne him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

35.web: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time will I praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
35.asv: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, This time will I praise Jehovah: therefore she called his name Judah; and she left off bearing.
